mail.subject: Your sign-in link for {{org}}
mail.heading: Sign in to {{org}}
mail.body: Open the link below to sign in to your client space. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
mail.ignore: If you did not ask to sign in, you can ignore this email. Nobody can sign in without this link.
mail.footer: You are receiving this because a sign-in to the client portal was asked for this address.

page.requested: If this address has access, a sign-in link is on its way. Check your inbox.
page.linkInvalid: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one.
page.totpPrompt: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
page.totpInvalid: That code did not work. Try again.
page.unavailable: The client portal is not available right now.

reply.subject: A reply on your request: {{subject}}
reply.heading: You have a reply
reply.body: You have a reply on {{subject}}. Sign in to read it.
reply.footer: You are receiving this because you sent this request from the client portal of {{org}}.

invite.subject: {{org}} invites you to your client portal
invite.heading: Your portal for {{company}}
invite.body: {{org}} opened a client portal for {{company}}. Sign in with this address: each time, a link comes by email, with no password.
invite.footer: If you did not expect this, you can ignore it.

totpReset.subject: Your client portal's second step was reset
totpReset.heading: Your second step was reset
totpReset.body: Someone at {{org}} reset your authenticator for the client portal. At your next sign-in you set one up again. If you did not ask for this, reply to this email.
totpReset.footer: You are receiving this because you have access to the client portal of {{org}}.
